Description: Byeori student question service (docs/LAB-QUESTION-WORKFLOW.md): AWS_IAM Function URL gateway, answer-only, triage and approved-research workers over the shared wiki, control table and queues. Only the research worker may write wiki pages, and only inside an approval's scope; no function may write papers/ or index/. The research event source is created only when ResearchConsumerEnabled is true.

DataBucket.Description: Existing Byeori data bucket: wiki, index and runs/lab-questions receipts

OutboxScheduleEnabled.Description: true runs the outbox relay every minute (triage and offers follow answers automatically); false parks it

ArtifactBucket.Description: Bucket holding the zipped src/ package

ArtifactKey.Description: Key of the zipped src/ package (cfn/lab/<sha256>.zip)

ParameterKmsKeyArn.Description: KMS key that encrypts the Jev SecureString parameter

ResearchConsumerEnabled.Description: true attaches the research queue to the research function and lets the relay send research rows; false keeps the code path inert

ResearchModelId.Description: Bedrock model or inference profile the approved research worker calls

ResearchReasoning.Description: Adaptive-thinking effort for wiki-writing research (the user unified every model on Opus 5 at high, 2026-09-23)

Properties.Description: Verifies the IAM caller, records questions and serves bounded wiki reads
Answer-only worker: bounded evidence packet, at most two model calls, zero wiki writes
Asynchronous Jev triage of saved answers; issues synthesis offers at the 0.99 cutoff
Relays pending outbox rows to the work queues and marks them sent
Outbox relay schedule; enabled since the user opened the service on 2026-09-22, parked with OutboxScheduleEnabled=false
Approved research worker: one attempt reservation, the campaign engine under a scoped publisher, receipts under runs/lab-questions/; consumes its queue only when ResearchConsumerEnabled is true
Students: invoke the Byeori gateway URL with IAM auth, nothing else
Administrators: gateway URL, member registry maintenance, receipt reads and manual outbox relay

GatewayUrl.Description: Function URL the student MCP client signs requests for

ResearchQueueUrl.Description: Research queue; its consumer is attached only when ResearchConsumerEnabled is true
